title: Stand-Alone Fitting Allowance Following the Member's Contact Lenses — Vision Plans
content:
**Benefit note — Vision Plans stand-alone contact-lens fittings**

The stand-alone fitting allowance follows the contact lenses the fitting serves. These are the latest contact-lens service of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, when it is dated no more than 60 calendar days before or after the fitting.
- When that latest service is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none, and no earlier one is looked at.
- Of several such services on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing.

| Contact lenses the fitting serves | Fitting allowance |
|---|---|
| Certified by the provider as medically necessary | 120.00 |
| Elective | The plan's specialty fitting allowance (50.00 on Essential 100 and Select 130, 60.00 on Select 150 and Choice 175, 75.00 on Premier 200, 0.00 on Exam Plus) |
| No such contact lenses on record within the window | None (0.00) |

**Window boundary (hypothetical dates).** A fitting on 20 November and latest paid contact lenses dated 21 September (60 days earlier): within the window. Dated 20 September (61 days earlier): outside it, and the fitting has no allowance from this rule. The same applies to contact lenses dated after the fitting, up to 60 days after it.

*Hypothetical case.* The latest reimbursed contact lenses, certified for anisometropia of 3 diopters or more, are dated 12 days after the fitting: the allowance is 120.00.
